excerpt.zh: 作为我们合约的一部分，最后一批囚犯已经卸客。我们已尽力保持谨慎，但总是存在被发现的风险，且人们在面对突然涌入的外星罪犯时，很少会感到愉快。
excerpt.en: The last prisoners carried as part of our contract have been disembarked. We have tried our best to remain discreet, but detection is always a risk, and people are rarely pleased when faced with a sudden influx of xeno criminals.

texts.zh: 作为我们合约的一部分，最后一批囚犯已经卸客。我们已尽力保持谨慎，但总是存在被发现的风险，且人们在面对突然涌入的外星罪犯时，很少会感到愉快。
texts.en: The last prisoners carried as part of our contract have been disembarked. We have tried our best to remain discreet, but detection is always a risk, and people are rarely pleased when faced with a sudden influx of xeno criminals.

tooltips.zh: 罪犯£pop£ 人口被转移至[From.GetName]
tooltips.en: The Criminal £pop£ Pops are transferred to [From.GetName]

texts.zh: 我们参与运输罪犯人口的消息尚未传开。看来我们还没有被发现。
texts.en: Word of our involvement in the transport of criminal pops has yet to spread. It seems we have not been detected.

texts.zh: 我们试图欺骗[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]，但是失败了。虽然罪犯已成功卸载，但我们的行动已被发现，[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]已取消合约并拒绝向我们支付报酬。
texts.en: Our attempt at double crossing the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] has failed. While the criminals have been successfully disembarked, we have been detected and the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] has cancelled the contract and refuse to pay us.

texts.zh: 虽然我们的行动已被发现，但[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]依然很高兴我们帮他们处理掉了罪犯，并同意向我们全额支付报酬。
texts.en: While we have been detected, the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] is still pleased that we rid them of their criminals, and have agreed to pay us in full.
